The '''Hynese''' were the population of the [[Factory world/Legends|industrial world]] [[Hynah]]. An entrepreneurial and cosmopolitan society, the Hynese consisted of members of various different [[Species/Legends|species]] and had economic interests in the adjacent [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
